question: Sponsor match-documentation features: for the top-15 sponsors, record from public help pages whether a donor can download a grant confirmation suitable for an employer match (donor name, date, charity EIN, amount), whether the sponsor integrates with Benevity/YourCause/CyberGrants match portals, and whether any sponsor states a policy on employer matching
